'''Hematite''' is the pack's name for iron ore.

The deepslate variant is '''deepslate hematite'''.

== Obtaining ==
=== Natural generation ===
As vanilla iron ore.

=== Breaking ===
Mined with a pickaxe (see [[Tools#Mining levels]]), hematite uses the vanilla loot table: 1 raw iron, affected by Fortune, with no bonus from electrum or adamant tools. Deepslate hematite drops 2 raw iron, affected by Fortune and electrum, and adamant tools drop 2 iron ingots instead.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/minecraft/loot_table/blocks/deepslate_iron_ore.json}}</ref> Silk Touch drops the block.
